sloka: तदागन्तव्यमनिशं भवद्भिरिह सङ्गतैः ।अगस्त्याद्यास्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषयः संशितव्रताः ।। ७.३६.६० ॥
transliteration: tadāgantavyamaniśaṁ bhavadbhiriha saṅgataiḥ ।agastyādyāstu tacchrutvā ṛṣayaḥ saṁśitavratāḥ ।। 7.36.60 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, you should constantly come here assembled together; and Agastya and other sages of firm vows, having heard that (request)...
